ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Error payload returned when Massive cannot authorize or fulfill a request.

request_id.description: Server-assigned request identifier for support and diagnostics.

AggregateBar.title: AggregateBar
AggregateBar.description: OHLC aggregate constructed from qualifying trades in one time window.

T.description: Exchange ticker symbol; commonly present in previous-day responses.

n.description: Number of transactions in the aggregate window.

otc.description: True for an OTC aggregate; omitted when false.

t.description: Window start as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

adjusted.description: Whether prices are adjusted for splits.

queryCount.description: Number of base minute or day aggregates queried.

results.description: An array of results containing the requested data.

next_url.description: Absolute URL for the next page, when present. Authentication may still need to be supplied.

ds.description: Trade size including any fractional component, encoded as a decimal string.

f.description: Trade Reporting Facility receipt time as a Unix timestamp in nanoseconds.

i.description: Trade identifier, unique per ticker/exchange/TRF combination.

q.description: Increasing event sequence number for the ticker; gaps are possible.

t.description: SIP receipt time as a Unix timestamp in nanoseconds.

x.description: Exchange identifier; resolve through Massive exchange reference data.

y.description: Participant/exchange event time as a Unix timestamp in nanoseconds.

SnapshotSession.title: SnapshotSession
SnapshotSession.description: Metrics for the current trading session; availability varies by asset class and entitlement.

last_updated.description: Last update as a Unix timestamp in nanoseconds.

ticker.description: The ticker symbol for the asset.

type.description: The asset class for this ticker.

market_status.description: The market status for the market that trades this ticker. Possible values for stocks, options, crypto, and forex snapshots are open, closed, early_trading, or late_trading. Possible values for indices snapshots are regular_trading, closed, early_trading, and late_trading.

fmv.description: Massive Fair Market Value; limited to eligible Business plans.

fmv_last_updated.description: FMV calculation time as a Unix timestamp in nanoseconds.

next_url.description: Absolute URL for the next page, when present.

request_id.description: A request id assigned by the server.

results.description: An array of results containing the requested data.

status.description: The status of this request's response.

active.description: Whether the asset was actively traded on the queried date.

base_currency_name.description: The name of the currency that this asset is priced against.

base_currency_symbol.description: ISO 4217 code of the priced-against currency.

cik.description: The CIK number for this ticker.

composite_figi.description: The composite OpenFIGI number for this ticker.

currency_name.description: The name of the currency that this asset is traded with.

delisted_utc.description: The last date that the asset was traded.

last_updated_utc.description: The information is accurate up to this time.

market.description: The market type of the asset.

name.description: The name of the asset. For stocks/equities this will be the companies registered name. For crypto/fx this will be the name of the currency or coin pair.

primary_exchange.description: ISO 10383 MIC of the primary exchange.

share_class_figi.description: The share Class OpenFIGI number for this ticker.

ticker.description: The exchange symbol that this item is traded under.

count.description: The total number of results for this request.

next_url.description: Absolute URL for the next page, when present.

request_id.description: A request id assigned by the server.

results.description: An array of tickers that match your query. Note: Although you can query by CUSIP, due to legal reasons we do not return the CUSIP in the response.

status.description: The status of this request's response.

Branding.title: Branding
Branding.description: Visual-branding URLs may require the same API key when fetched.

description.description: A description of the company and what they do/offer.
examples: Apple designs a wide variety of consumer electronic devices, including smartphones (iPhone), tablets (iPad), PCs (Mac), smartwatches (Apple Watch), AirPods, and TV boxes (Apple TV), among others.

homepage_url.description: The URL of the company's website homepage.

list_date.description: The date that the symbol was first publicly listed in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

market_cap.description: The most recent close price of the ticker multiplied by weighted outstanding shares.

phone_number.description: The phone number for the company behind this ticker.

round_lot.description: Round lot size of this security.

share_class_shares_outstanding.description: The recorded number of outstanding shares for this particular share class.

sic_code.description: The standard industrial classification code for this ticker.

sic_description.description: A description of this ticker's SIC code.

ticker_root.description: The root of a specified ticker. For example, the root of BRK.A is BRK.

ticker_suffix.description: The suffix of a specified ticker. For example, the suffix of BRK.A is A.

total_employees.description: The approximate number of employees for the company.

weighted_shares_outstanding.description: The shares outstanding calculated assuming all shares of other share classes are converted to this share class.

count.description: The total number of results for this request.

request_id.description: A request id assigned by the server.

status.description: The status of this request's response.

getLastTrade.description: Retrieve the latest available trade for a case-sensitive stock ticker. The result includes price, size, exchange, conditions, and nanosecond timestamps when supplied by the feed. Availability and recency depend on the account's stock-data plan.

default.description: Request failed because of authentication, authorization, validation, rate limiting, or a server error.

documentation.stabilityNote: Officially documented endpoint; availability depends on the account's market-data plan.

getPreviousClose.description: Retrieve the previous trading day's OHLC, volume, VWAP, and transaction count for a stock ticker. Results are split-adjusted by default.

default.description: Request failed because of authentication, authorization, validation, rate limiting, or a server error.

getAggregateBars.description: Retrieve historical OHLC and volume bars over a custom date range in Eastern Time. Bars are built from qualifying trades; an interval with no eligible trades is omitted rather than returned as an empty bar.

default.description: Request failed because of authentication, authorization, validation, rate limiting, or a server error.

schema.description: Start date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format or Unix timestamp in milliseconds.
End date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format or Unix timestamp in milliseconds.
Whether results are adjusted for stock splits.
Order bars by their start timestamp.
Maximum number of base aggregates queried to construct results.

getMarketSnapshot.description: Retrieve paginated snapshots across stocks, options, forex, crypto, and indices. A snapshot can include current session metrics plus the latest trade, quote, and minute bar according to plan entitlements.

default.description: Request failed because of authentication, authorization, validation, rate limiting, or a server error.

schema.description: Order results using the selected sort field.

documentation.stabilityNote: Official unified snapshot endpoint; returned fields and recency vary by asset-class subscription.

listTickers.description: Retrieve a paginated list of ticker symbols across supported asset classes. Filter by symbol, asset type, market, exchange, identifiers, date, search text, or active status.

default.description: Request failed because of authentication, authorization, validation, rate limiting, or a server error.

schema.description: Ticker type code from the Ticker Types endpoint.
Primary exchange Market Identifier Code (MIC), for example `XNAS`.
CUSIP to query. CUSIPs may be used as filters but are not returned for legal reasons.
Point-in-time date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format; defaults to the latest available date.
Search text matched against ticker symbols and company names.
Order results using the selected sort field.
Maximum number of results per page.

getTickerDetails.description: Get ticker reference details. Official reference-data endpoint.

default.description: Request failed because of authentication, authorization, validation, rate limiting, or a server error.

schema.description: Point-in-time date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format; defaults to the latest available date.

info.title: Massive Stock Market Data API
info.description: Curated read-only Massive stock market REST API surface for quotes, aggregates, snapshots, and ticker reference data. Massive was formerly Polygon.io; endpoint access, recency, and history vary by subscription plan.
